films.title: The Blair Witch Project
films.overview: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.

films.title: Solstice
films.overview: While on a summer trip with her friends, Megan begins to feel the presence of Sophie, her twin sister who recently committed suicide.

films.title: The Objective
films.overview: A team of US Special Ops forces is dispatched to a remote mountain region of Afghanistan with orders to locate an influential Muslim cleric. While on the mission they find themselves lost in a Middle Eastern 'Bermuda Triangle' of ancient evil and faced with an enemy that none of them could have imagined.

films.title: Curse of the Blair Witch
films.overview: A mockumentary exploring the legend of the Blair Witch and the case of the three missing student filmmakers.
